Why infunion

A lighter workload for the team, a closer community

Fewer calls to the team

Sign-ups, appointments, certificates: requests arrive online with the required documents, and each member can track their request without having to call.

Contributions straight to your account

One-off or monthly, in the app or with a pay link and QR code anyone can use: card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, no app or account needed. The money goes straight to your community's own account, with a tax receipt for every contribution.

Every member reached

Bring in the member list you already have and write to everyone, in the app or by email. Schedules, news and notifications reach the right people at the right time.

Getting started

Your community online in three steps

  1. 1

    We set up your space with you

    Introduction, schedules, home page, your member list: we configure your space alongside you, in a single day.

  2. 2

    You choose your modules

    The Basic plan is free, with the Events and Donate modules. Essentials and Complete can each be tried free for one month.

  3. 3

    Your members find you and join

    They get your invitation by email, find you in the app or on your community's website, or scan the QR code on the flyer generated from the dashboard.

The dashboard

Centralised management, simple and clear

Designed for the teams who run the community, with no technical knowledge required.

Every request at a glance

From the moment they sign in, the team sees new requests, members awaiting a reply and the week's activities. Each request brings together its status, appointments, documents and message history.

A personalised home page, previewed live

Important notice, opening hours, contribution campaign: build the app's home page and see how it looks on a phone in real time. Save a version and switch back to it in one click.

Write to every member, in the app or not

Import the list you already have, from Excel, a CSV file or Google Sheets, and check it before anything is saved. Then invite people to the app, ask for a contribution or send news by email, and see who opened it, joined or contributed.

  • ✓ Invitations on every plan, other messages from Essentials
  • ✓ Each email shows your community's name and logo
  • ✓ Anyone can stop the emails in one click

A pay link and a QR code for every occasion

Create a link for a fee, a trip or a project, with a fixed or free amount and a last day if you want. Share it or print its poster: people pay by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, without the app and without an account.

  • ✓ Paid straight into your community's own account
  • ✓ Totals for each link in the dashboard
  • ✓ Available from the free Basic plan

Your community's website, ready-made

Switch it on and share the link: news, the weekly timetable, campaigns and the map, built from what you already keep up to date in the app. Visitors are invited to join you in the app.

Your members find you in seconds

Every community appears on the infunion map. From the app, future members can find you in three ways.

  • ✓ Nearby: their location, used once and never stored, sorts communities by distance, as a list or on a map.

  • ✓ By scanning the QR code on your flyer, or typing in your community's code.

Look around first

An AI assistant answers members' questions about the community: times, how to sign up, where to go. Complete plan.

FAQ

Your questions, our answers

Do we need technical skills?

No. The dashboard can be used without any special training, and we set up your space with you at the start.

How long does it take to get started?

One day. We create your space together, you print the flyer, and your members can join the app the same day.

Is there a commitment?

No. Each module can be switched off in one click from the dashboard, with no data lost.

Where is our data hosted, and how is it protected?

On servers located in Europe, in line with the GDPR. Members give their consent when they join, can download their data and delete their account from the app, and you can export all your community's data at any time.

Do members need to create an account?

No. They can look around and get notifications without an account. To make a request or contribute, they sign in with their email or phone number, with no password to remember.

Which communities is infunion for?

Every kind: associations, clubs, cultural and sports groups, places of worship. You switch on only the modules you need, and we develop new ones around your needs.

How do contributions reach us?

Straight into your community's own Stripe account, then to your bank. Members pay in the app or through your pay links, by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay.
